_note.en: Reference (example) loss factors of the performance-ratio method PR = (1 - A - Ptemp) * B * C * D * E * F, as given in an Argentine PV design course (UTN Buenos Aires e-learning, module 2 unit 3, figure 'reference losses'). They are illustrative typical values, not values of a standard. Fractions, not percent. Not wired into params.json; the owner decides if and how they replace the typical values there. Not verified (status pending review).
_note.es: Factores de perdida de referencia (ejemplo) del metodo de performance ratio PR = (1 - A - Ptemp) * B * C * D * E * F, segun un curso argentino de diseno FV (UTN Buenos Aires e-learning, modulo 2 unidad 3, figura 'perdidas de referencia'). Son valores tipicos ilustrativos, no de una norma. Fracciones, no porcentaje. No conectados a params.json; el dueno decide si reemplazan alli los valores tipicos. No verificado (status pending review).

source.title: Factibilidad tecnica y economica, performance ratio (course material)
source.publisher: UTN Buenos Aires, Centro de e-Learning SCEU

temperature_loss_note: Ptemp = |alpha| * (Tc - 25), Tc = Tamb + (NOCT - 20) * G / 800; the course states about 0.4 %/C for a typical module and notes that some regulations use a fixed G between 500 and 850 W/m2.
